title: Eludite MCP resource
description: How Eludite's MCP server exposes a guide for agents as an MCP resource (MCP Resources, revision 2025-06-18 and later): `initialize` advertises the `resources` capability; `resources/list` answers `{"resources": [<this object>]}` in one page (no `nextCursor`); `resources/read` with `{"uri"}` answers `{"contents": [{"uri", "mimeType", "text"}]}` and an unknown uri is the JSON-RPC error -32002 (resource not found) naming it; `resources/templates/list` answers `{"resourceTemplates": []}`. The guides are compiled into Eludite from `docs/agents/`, so they match the commands of the build. The first is `eludite://guides/debugging` (`docs/agents/debugging.md`, `text/markdown`): how an agent should drive the debugger (eludite.debug.*). Besides the guides, `eludite://git/status` (`application/json`, brief 0040) is the repository's status as eludite.git.status answers it, read afresh on each `resources/read`; the guide `eludite://guides/git` (`docs/agents/git.md`) says how an agent uses eludite.git.*, and `eludite://guides/terminal` (`docs/agents/terminal.md`, brief 0041) how it runs commands in the integrated terminal (eludite.terminal.*). `eludite://forge/pull/current` (`application/json`, brief 0046) is the current branch's pull request as eludite.forge.pull answers it with `threads: unresolved` (or `{"pull": null}` when the branch has none), read afresh on each `resources/read`; the guide `eludite://guides/forge` (`docs/agents/forge.md`) says how an agent answers the review comments on its pull request.

templates_list_result.description: `resources/templates/list`'s result: Eludite has no resource templates.
